product.name: Digital Advertising Solutions
product.description: Services that enable advertisers to place and manage advertising campaigns on major digital platforms globally, including campaign setup, management, and reporting.

product.name: Cross-Border Credit and Payment Solutions
product.description: End-to-end payment and credit services that handle local billing, taxes, collections, and currency conversions to facilitate global digital advertising transactions.

product.name: Digital Ad Expert Education Platform
product.description: An online education initiative providing digital marketing training and certification to individuals and organizations worldwide, focusing on emerging markets.

product.description: Consulting and operational support services that help digital media platforms and advertisers expand into new international markets with local market knowledge.

product.description: Custom-built technology tools designed to optimize digital advertising campaigns across multiple platforms.
